policy: Hotplug is an explicit claim, never an accidental consequence of udev visibility. The first Debian ARM64 QEMU fast path may omit hotplug when using fixed FDT-discovered VirtIO-MMIO devices.

virtio-mmio-fast-path.reason: The selected MMIO platform devices are fixed by the QEMU/FDT boot topology; Step 38 must not invent a remove/re-add claim.

virtio-pci-fallback.activation_condition: Only if Step33/34 explicitly select the PCI fallback and the corresponding PCI/IRQ/DMA runtime owners are released.

evidence_rule: A final Step38 handoff must name exactly one selected transport profile and may require hotplug evidence only where that profile marks the claim true.
